title: NMEA 2000 bus
description: The pins the CAN transceiver is wired to. -1 uses this firmware's default for the chip, which the README lists per board. A pin that cannot carry CAN on this chip leaves the bus stopped and says why in the log.

keys.name: tx_pin
keys.title: CAN TX pin
keys.description: GPIO wired to the transceiver's TXD (CTX on most modules).

keys.name: rx_pin
keys.title: CAN RX pin
keys.description: GPIO wired to the transceiver's RXD (CRX on most modules).

keys.name: transmit
keys.title: Send to the bus
keys.description: Write frames that signalk-server sends onto the bus. Off makes the gateway receive only, for a boat where nothing should ever originate frames from this device.
